prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: main-menu parallax layer 1 SKY ONLY. Edit the provided scene as the exact reference. Output exactly 2580x1080, same full-frame aspect, no crop or reframing. Isolate ONLY the smoky orange-to-deep-blue dusk sky with soft clouds and the faint diffuse glow of the burning castle on the horizon. Preserve the original cloud placement, sun location, painterly pixel-art style, dark navy left and orange right palette. Remove ALL mountains, castle, towers, land, valley, river, bridge, trees, rocks and embers. Naturally extend the sky/cloud field over all previously occluded regions, including the lower canvas. No horizon land silhouettes. Fully opaque sky filling every pixel. No text, logo, watermark. This is one separate layer, never a collage or layer preview.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset: main-menu parallax layer 2 FAR ONLY. Edit the attached main-menu scene as exact reference. Output exactly 2580x1080 on genuine transparent RGBA background. Preserve full-frame original positions and scale, no crop, no centering of isolated objects, no reframing. Keep ONLY distant mountains, the hilltop castle at upper right with its burning tower, its distant rocky hill and the far valley. Restore occluded distant landscape naturally where nearer objects were removed. Remove sky to alpha=0 above the mountain/castle silhouette. Remove ALL nearer river, bridge, ruined central watchtower, foreground or midground trees, foreground cliffs, grass and rocks to transparency. The castle stays at its original upper-right location (roughly x .78-.96, y .10-.31), mountain ridge roughly y .21-.36. Same painterly pixel-art style and exact navy/slate/orange palette. Crisp cutout edges with true transparency, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no text or logo. One separate full-canvas layer.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset: main-menu parallax layer 3 MIDDLE ONLY. Use attached scene as exact edit target. Output exactly 2580x1080, full reference frame retained, true transparent RGBA background. Isolate ONLY valley floor, river, stone bridge with its broken standalone piers, ruined watchtower at central x .51 y .32-.47 and its rocky support, mid-distance river banks. Preserve all original positions and scale: bridge x .56-.72 y .56-.72, detached piers extending toward x .86, river flows diagonally from x .69 y .4 toward lower middle/right. Extend these middle surfaces naturally where foreground trees covered them. ALL sky, far mountains, distant castle and castle hill, foreground pine trees, foreground cliffs/rocks/grass must be alpha=0. Do not move tower or bridge, do not recenter or crop. Retain exact painterly pixel-art palette, warm orange river reflection, slate rocks, dusk lighting. No isolated embers, no text, no logo, no borders, no painted checkerboard. One separate layer.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset: main-menu parallax layer 4 FOREGROUND ONLY. Edit provided main-menu scene as exact reference. Output exactly 2580x1080 with actual transparent RGBA background. Preserve original full frame positions and scale; do not recenter, crop or rearrange. Keep ONLY dark silhouetted pine trees and mist on the LEFT THIRD (x 0 to .333) plus rocks or grass along the VERY BOTTOM EDGE. Left trees start near top left and form the same calm dark mass; mist is semitransparent blue-grey painterly pixel mist threaded among those trees. Bottom rocks/grass may extend across the bottom at their original positions but no new tall trees outside left third. Remove EVERYTHING else: sky, mountains, castle, valley floor, river, bridge, ruined watchtower and all middle/far landscape to true transparency. Keep the left third dark and calm for future logo/menu, no bright accents. Match exact navy-charcoal painterly pixel-art style and crisp pine silhouettes. No text, no logo, no embers, no checkerboard painted as background. One separate full-canvas layer.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: medieval dusk main-menu VFX sprite sheet. Reference image is ONLY for painterly pixel-art style and navy/slate/grey-brown/orange palette, do not include its landscape. Output exactly 1024x512 pixels, transparent RGBA background. Strict invisible 4 columns by 2 rows grid, each cell EXACTLY 256x256 pixels. No visible grid lines or labels. Each effect stays ALONE within its assigned cell with at least 16px empty margin on all four edges. Top row left to right: cell 1 large very soft-edged grey-brown smoke puff; cell 2 thinner wispy smoke curl; cell 3 small cluster of glowing orange embers exactly 5 to 8 dots of different sizes; cell 4 single bright ember with soft glow. Bottom row left to right: cell 5 tall burning-tower flame tongue FOUR distinct slightly different animation frames side by side INSIDE that ONE 256px cell, aligned on same baseline, each within its own 56px slot, none overlap; cell 6 drifting ash flake cluster in grey; cell 7 soft circular warm light glow; cell 8 small crow silhouette in flight TWO different wing-pose animation frames side by side INSIDE that ONE cell. True alpha transparency around elements and semi-transparent soft smoke/glow edges. Preserve readable painterly pixel texture for smoke and fire, crisp pixel crow. No environment, tower, trees, text, logo, border or painted checkerboard. Exactly eight cells, not a collage of landscapes.
